answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric verification acts as a zephyr of truth against Sybil threats. By binding agents to unique physical entropy, it renders the cost of forging identities prohibitive, akin to minting a sonnet in pure copper. An attacker would be forced to acquire distinct, non-replicable biological markers for every node, effectively capping network saturation at the scale of human population and neutralizing the economic incentive to deploy thousands of fraudulent sub-agents.
